mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sms_activation (activation_id, phone_number, service_code, country_id, cost, currency, state, cancel_after, expires_at, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{activationId}, #{phoneNumber}, #{serviceCode}, #{countryId}, #{cost}, #{currency}, #{state}, #{cancelAfter}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sms_activation ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
